scope: All originally registered six-external tasks, variants, tracks and ten seeds. New complete run; never merge scientific scores from v1.
budget_unit: one scalar target, including each ODE derivative component
clock: Data-dependent fitting/optimization/decoding is search. Imports and synthetic compilation warmup are separate; exports and held-out scoring are separate and measured. Native evaluation counts are descriptive, never equalized across algorithms.
preprocessing: train_max_abs_multiplicative_no_center_v1; angular radian columns retain scale1; inverse transform predictions and expression text; no validation/test statistics
selection: minimum validation MSE, then native complexity, then expression text; load test only after freezing selection; retain invalid outcomes
operator_scope: Native-method comparison under common compute, not an identical-grammar experiment. Document protected versus ordinary operators, AI-Feynman's fixed grammar, and pretrained TF4SR grammar separately.

pysr.numeric_export: native CSV operation order, no symbolic rewriting

operon.native_scalar: installed build; record actual dtype; train scaling avoids physical-unit overflow

gplearn.exp: ordinary NumPy exp via native make_function

ai_feynman_2.gradient_guard: scaled float64 for degenerate gradients; regular native path unchanged

tf4sr.decode: single greedy with valid input-variable and tree-completion mask
tf4sr.constants: shared positive C matching native symbol assumptions; train-only max_nfev200
tf4sr.overlap: unknown; separate pretrained stratum; no unseen-formula claim

mysr.execution: later, same frozen data/scales/seed/track/one physical CPU and validation-only selection
mysr.priors: no reference equation, held-out data or task-specific tuning; document algorithm features and training provenance

not_applicable: Preserve the original method registry and documented dimensional/input requirements; never exclude a task because its fitted model failed.

failure_metrics.primary: prediction coverage and fixed-threshold NRMSE attainment over all registered applicable fits
failure_metrics.conditional_error: supplement with denominator; do not silently drop failures

prior_results: Retained unchanged as v1; no selection of the best test outcome across epochs or retries.
